items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: George Shilling was a trombone player with Johnny Fisher.

ctx.x: Emile's brother. Emile, yeah. Frank. Bill Gallaty. Tom Brown. Jack Lane. Johnny Fisher. George Shilling was a trombone player with Johnny Fisher. Then he broke up and George Shilling went, you know, and he'd make a drum deck. And at that time, I'll tell you who was playing drum. He was a retired policeman now. Freddie Williams. Yes. Remember?
